native.notes: Bootstrap / Gaussian copula (mixed types) / SMOTE wrap. Core numpy/scipy/sklearn; SMOTE needs buildml[imbalanced].

sdv.notes: SDV CTGAN / TVAE / CopulaGAN deep tabular synthesizers (buildml[synthetic-industry]). Not differential privacy.

sdmetrics.notes: SDMetrics QualityReport when sdmetrics is installed; falls back to built-in KS/TV/corr fidelity otherwise.

great_expectations.notes: Optional GE PandasDataset expectations when great_expectations is separately installed; built-in validation always runs.

install_hints.synthetic-industry: pip install 'buildml[synthetic-industry]'  # SDV CTGAN/TVAE/CopulaGAN + SDMetrics quality reports
install_hints.imbalanced: pip install 'buildml[imbalanced]'  # native method='smote' via imbalanced-learn

cross_links.resample: Session.resample is class-balance preprocessing (mutates train). fit_synthesizer fits a reusable generator; merge is explicit.

non_goals: Time-series / sequential SDV models in this tabular path
capability_matrix.synthetic_vs_resample: Synthetic path: reusable generator + optional extend_train merge. Resample path: in-place class rebalance preprocess.
